//: Profile: the public OPC UA demo server, for when you want to run without Docker.
//caveat: This is somebody else's server on the public internet. It needs outbound
TCP 26543, it can be down or busy, and it only accepts an unsecured
endpoint — which is why UseSecurity is false here and nowhere else.
The Docker Compose profile is the supported one; this exists to show that
the endpoint is configuration rather than something compiled in.
//nodes: Configuration arrays merge by index, they do not replace. This list must
therefore be at least as long as the one in appsettings.json, or trailing
entries from that file survive into this profile. Keep the counts equal.
